019package org.apache.bcel.verifier.exc;
020
021/**
022 * Instances of this class are thrown by BCEL's class file verifier "JustIce" when a class file to verify does not pass
023 * one of the verification passes 2 or 3. Note that the pass 3 used by "JustIce" involves verification that is usually
024 * delayed to pass 4. The name of this class is justified by the Java Virtual Machine Specification, 2nd edition, page
025 * 164, 5.4.1 where verification as a part of the linking process is defined to be the verification happening in passes
026 * 2 and 3.
027 */
028public abstract class VerificationException extends VerifierConstraintViolatedException {
029    private static final long serialVersionUID = 8012776320318623652L;
030
031    /**
032     * Constructs a new VerificationException with null as its error message string.
033     */
034    VerificationException() {
035    }
036
037    /**
038     * Constructs a new VerificationException with the specified error message.
039     */
040    VerificationException(final String message) {
041        super(message);
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * Constructs a new VerificationException with the specified error message and exception
046     */
047    VerificationException(final String message, final Throwable initCause) {
048        super(message, initCause);
049    }
050}
